text:
A pulse of sound is produced at the bottom of a boat. The sound travels through the water and is
reflected from the seabed. The reflected sound reaches the boat 1.3s after the sound was
produced. The seabed is 1000m below the boat.
boat
1000m
seabed
Using this information, what is the speed of sound in the water?
A
770m/s
B
1300m/s
C
1500m/s
D
2600m/s
subject: Physics
